course_name: CHEMISTRY FOR INFORMATION SCIENCE AND ELECTRICAL SCIENCE

topics_generated.title: Electrochemical Cell - Electrode potential- Nernst equation for single electrode and cell (Numerical problems)- Reference electrodes – SHE & Calomel electrode –Construction and Working - Electrochemical series - Applications – Glass Electrode & pH Measurement-Conductivity- Measurement using Digital conductivity meter. Li-ion battery & H 2-O2 fuel cell (acid electrolyte only) construction and working.
